FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_FreightRail_ShunterTractiveEffort
(* ====================================================================================================
   CYBER-PHYSICAL AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE FOR HEAVY-HAUL FREIGHT RAIL SHUNTING ROBOTS
   DOMAIN: HYBRID BATTERY-SUPERCAPACITOR DYNAMIC TRACTIVE EFFORT & AUTOMATED JANNEY COUPLER ARTICULATION
   STANDARDS COMPLIANCE: IEC 61131-3 3RD ED., EN 50126/EN 50128/EN 50129 (SIL 4), AAR S-100 / UIC 541-05
   AUTHOR: V7 MAX-PERSONA, PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR
   ==================================================================================================== *)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Primary Supervisor & Emergency Safety Interlocks --- *)
    bEnable                     : BOOL;     (* Master automation enable signal from Yard Supervisory Dispatch [TRUE=Active] *)
    bEmergencyStop              : BOOL;     (* Hardwired fail-safe dual-channel safety relay OK signal [TRUE=Healthy, FALSE=E-Stop] *)
    bYardSafetyFenceInterlock   : BOOL;     (* Intermodal yard optical perimeter fence clearance signal [TRUE=Clear] *)
    bBrakePipePressureCharged   : BOOL;     (* Train line pneumatic brake pipe status [TRUE=Charged >= 480 kPa / 4.8 bar] *)

    (* --- Vehicle Dynamics & Yard Dispatch Setpoints --- *)
    rTargetVelocity             : REAL;     (* Desired consist velocity setpoint [km/h], range: 0.0 to 25.0 km/h *)
    rConsistMass_Te             : REAL;     (* Total trailing consist mass estimate from yard manifest [t], range: 50.0 to 14000.0 t *)
    rTrackGradient_Permille     : REAL;     (* Track inclination profile [permille or mm/m], range: -35.0 to +35.0 permille *)
    rTrackCurvatureRadius_m     : REAL;     (* Track curve radius [m], range: 100.0 to 5000.0 m (0.0 = tangent track) *)
    rAmbientTemperature_DegC    : REAL;     (* Yard ambient temperature [-40.0 to +55.0 deg C] for thermal derating *)

    (* --- 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) Velocity Feedback --- *)
    rAxleSpeed_ChA              : REAL;     (* Channel A: Dual-beam Doppler rail ground speed radar [km/h] *)
    rAxleSpeed_ChB              : REAL;     (* Channel B: High-resolution phonic wheel axle optical encoder [km/h] *)
    rAxleSpeed_ChC              : REAL;     (* Channel C: Differential GNSS/INS Kalman dead-reckoning speed [km/h] *)

    (* --- Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) DC Bus Feedback --- *)
    rBatteryBusVoltage          : REAL;     (* Traction DC link main battery terminal voltage [V], nominal: 750.0 VDC (600.0 - 875.0 V) *)
    rBatteryCurrent             : REAL;     (* Battery pack DC current [A], discharge > 0, dynamic brake regen < 0 (-800.0 to +1200.0 A) *)
    rBatterySoC                 : REAL;     (* Battery pack Coulomb-counted State-of-Charge [%], 0.0 to 100.0% *)
    rBatteryCellMaxTemp_DegC    : REAL;     (* Peak individual cell temperature across battery modules [deg C], max: 55.0 deg C *)

    rSuperCapVoltage            : REAL;     (* EDLC Ultra-capacitor bank voltage [V], nominal: 480.0 VDC (220.0 - 540.0 V) *)
    rSuperCapCurrent            : REAL;     (* Supercapacitor bidirectional DC-DC chopper output current [A], (-1500.0 to +1500.0 A) *)
    rSuperCapSoC                : REAL;     (* Supercapacitor bank electrostatic State-of-Charge [%], (E_cap ~ V^2) *)
    rSuperCapCoreTemp_DegC      : REAL;     (* EDLC internal core temperature [deg C], max: 65.0 deg C *)

    (* --- Automated Janney Coupler (AAR Type F / Type E Tightlock) Articulation & Vision Feedback --- *)
    rCouplerTargetDistance_m    : REAL;     (* Coaxial pulsed Time-of-Flight LiDAR distance to target knuckle [m], 0.0 to 25.0 m *)
    rCouplerLateralMisalign_mm  : REAL;     (* Dual stereoscopic machine vision knuckle lateral offset [mm], -300.0 to +300.0 mm *)
    rCouplerVerticalMisalign_mm : REAL;     (* Dual stereoscopic machine vision knuckle vertical height offset [mm], -150.0 to +150.0 mm *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Coupler Yaw Angle Feedback --- *)
    rCouplerAzimuth_ChA         : REAL;     (* Channel A: Absolute magnetic rotary resolver yaw angle [deg], -25.0 to +25.0 deg *)
    rCouplerAzimuth_ChB         : REAL;     (* Channel B: Optical multiturn absolute encoder yaw angle [deg], -25.0 to +25.0 deg *)
    rCouplerAzimuth_ChC         : REAL;     (* Channel C: Hall-effect linear displacement converted yaw angle [deg], -25.0 to +25.0 deg *)
    rCouplerElevation_deg       : REAL;     (* Hydraulic pitch cylinder inclinometer elevation angle [deg], -8.0 to +8.0 deg *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Coupler Drawbar Buff/Draft Load Feedback --- *)
    rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA       : REAL;     (* Channel A: Heavy-duty strain gauge drawbar load pin force [kN], -2500.0 to +2500.0 kN *)
    rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB       : REAL;     (* Channel B: Secondary redundant drawbar draft sensor force [kN], -2500.0 to +2500.0 kN *)
    rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC       : REAL;     (* Channel C: Piezoelectric dynamic impact load ring force [kN], -2500.0 to +2500.0 kN *)

    (* --- Coupler Discrete Sensors & Mode Control --- *)
    bCouplerKnuckleOpen         : BOOL;     (* Proximity sensor detecting Janney knuckle jaw is fully open for mating *)
    bCouplerKnuckleLatched      : BOOL;     (* Fail-safe dual magnetic proximity switch: locking pin dropped and locked [TRUE=Locked] *)
    bManualOverride             : BOOL;     (* Manual yard shunter joystick override requested [TRUE=Bypass Auto] *)
    bReset                      : BOOL;     (* Master fault reset acknowledge push-button *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Executive Status & Safety State Words --- *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Subsystem operational and ready for mission execution [TRUE=Ready] *)
    bActiveMission              : BOOL;     (* Shunter robot actively executing tractive haul or coupling sequence *)
    wOperationState             : WORD;     (* Hex-coded finite state machine state (0x0001=INIT, 0x0010=HAUL, 0x0040=COUPLE, etc.) *)
    wAlarmWord01                : WORD;     (* Primary critical safety alarms bitmask (E-Stop, Thermal, Derailment, Overvoltage) *)
    wAlarmWord02                : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and sensor degradation bitmask (2oo3 vote discrepancy, WSP slip, Comms) *)
    iDegradationLevel           : INT;      (* Active graceful degradation mode (0=Optimal, 1=SC Derated, 2=Bat Derated, 3=Crawl, 4=Halt) *)

    (* --- Hybrid Energy Storage System Commands --- *)
    rBatteryPowerCmd_kW         : REAL;     (* Inverter battery power baseline setpoint [kW], range: -600.0 to +800.0 kW *)
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW        : REAL;     (* Bi-directional DC-DC converter transient burst power setpoint [kW], (-1000.0 to +1000.0 kW) *)
    rTotalTractiveEffort_kN     : REAL;     (* Synthesized forward tractive effort command to wheelset AC induction motors [kN], max: 450.0 kN *)
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN        : REAL;     (* Dynamic electrodynamic regenerative braking force command [kN], max: 380.0 kN *)
    rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar : REAL;     (* Shunter locomotive pneumatic tread brake proportional cylinder pressure [bar], 0.0 to 3.8 bar *)

    (* --- Automated Janney Coupler Actuation Commands --- *)
    rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct     : REAL;     (* Proportional electro-hydraulic servo valve command for yaw positioning [%], -100.0 to +100.0% *)
    rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct   : REAL;     (* Proportional electro-hydraulic servo valve command for pitch positioning [%], -100.0 to +100.0% *)
    bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid  : BOOL;     (* Pneumatic uncoupling cylinder lock pin lift solenoid [TRUE=Release Pin, FALSE=Drop/Lock] *)
    bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd  : BOOL;     (* Automated air hose gladhand robotic sealing clamp command [TRUE=Clamped/Open] *)

    (* --- Telemetry, Diagnostics & Observers --- *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated consist velocity [km/h] *)
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg        : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated coupler articulation angle [deg] *)
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated drawbar tensile(+) or buff(-) load [kN] *)
    rCalculatedAdhesionCoeff    : REAL;     (* Curtius-Kniffler estimated rail-wheel adhesion limit coefficient mu [dimensionless] *)
    rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct    : REAL;     (* Real-time wheel slip/slide creep ratio lambda [%], nominal optimal: 1.5% to 3.5% *)
    rEstimatedCouplingImpact_kJ : REAL;     (* Estimated draft gear kinetic energy absorption at moment of impact [kJ] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* =========================================================================
       INTERNAL STATE ESTIMATION, DIGITAL FILTERING & 2oo3 TMR STRUCTURES
       ========================================================================= *)
    (* Velocity 2oo3 TMR voting internal registers *)
    bVelDiscrepancy_AB          : BOOL;
    bVelDiscrepancy_BC          : BOOL;
    bVelDiscrepancy_CA          : BOOL;
    tVelDiscrepancyTimer        : TON;
    rVelDiff_AB                 : REAL;
    rVelDiff_BC                 : REAL;
    rVelDiff_CA                 : REAL;

    (* Coupler Yaw 2oo3 TMR voting internal registers *)
    bYawDiscrepancy_AB          : BOOL;
    bYawDiscrepancy_BC          : BOOL;
    bYawDiscrepancy_CA          : BOOL;
    tYawDiscrepancyTimer        : TON;

    (* Draft Load 2oo3 TMR voting internal registers *)
    bLoadDiscrepancy_AB         : BOOL;
    bLoadDiscrepancy_BC         : BOOL;
    bLoadDiscrepancy_CA         : BOOL;
    tLoadDiscrepancyTimer       : TON;

    (* Digital low-pass filter state registers for Davis Train Resistance equation *)
    rFilteredVelocity           : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredPowerReq           : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredBatteryPower       : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Discrete State-Space Model Observer Matrices (Luenberger / Receding Horizon State Estimator)
       State Vector x = [v_consist (m/s), s_distance (m), F_tractive (N)]^T
       Discrete sampling period Ts = 10ms (0.01s) *)
    matA_11 : REAL := 0.9985;  matA_12 : REAL := 0.0000;  matA_13 : REAL := 0.000085;
    matA_21 : REAL := 0.0100;  matA_22 : REAL := 1.0000;  matA_23 : REAL := 0.0000004;
    matA_31 : REAL := -0.052;  matA_32 : REAL := 0.0000;  matA_33 : REAL := 0.9450;

    matB_11 : REAL := 0.000092;
    matB_21 : REAL := 0.0000005;
    matB_31 : REAL := 0.8500;

    matL_11 : REAL := 0.1250;  matL_12 : REAL := 0.0050;
    matL_21 : REAL := 0.0085;  matL_22 : REAL := 0.1500;
    matL_31 : REAL := 1.2500;  matL_32 : REAL := 0.0450;

    (* State estimate vectors *)
    rObsState_v_ms              : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated velocity in m/s *)
    rObsState_s_m               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated displacement in m *)
    rObsState_F_N               : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated drawbar tractive force in N *)

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Cost Weighting Factors *)
    rWeight_BatteryThermalRate  : REAL := 15.0;     (* Penalty on steep battery current gradients dI/dt *)
    rWeight_SuperCapSoCDrift    : REAL := 8.5;      (* Penalty on SC deviating from target 70% standby state *)
    rWeight_TractionJerkRate    : REAL := 22.0;     (* Penalty on train jerk d^3x/dt^3 to prevent broken knuckles *)
    rTargetSuperCapSoC          : REAL := 70.0;     (* Optimal standby SoC for dual-mode surge absorption [%] *)

    (* Curtius-Kniffler Rail Adhesion Constants (European Heavy Rail / AAR Profile) *)
    c_CK_A                      : REAL := 7.5;      (* Empirical Curtius-Kniffler parameter A *)
    c_CK_B                      : REAL := 44.0;     (* Velocity offset parameter B [km/h] *)
    c_CK_C                      : REAL := 0.161;    (* Asymptotic friction parameter C *)
    rRailConditionDerateFactor  : REAL := 1.0;      (* Surface factor: Dry=1.0, Wet=0.65, Icy/Oil-Slick=0.45 *)

    (* Davis Train Resistance Coefficients: F_res = A_davis + B_davis*v + C_davis*v^2 [N] *)
    c_Davis_A                   : REAL := 1.35;     (* Mechanical rolling resistance coefficient [N/t] *)
    c_Davis_B                   : REAL := 0.015;    (* Wheel flange friction coefficient [N/(t*(km/h))] *)
    c_Davis_C                   : REAL := 0.00035;  (* Aerodynamic drag drag coefficient [N/(t*(km/h)^2)] *)

    (* Wheel Slip/Slide Protection (WSP) Anti-Spin Controller *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor        : REAL := 1.0;      (* Dynamic tractive torque scaling [0.05 to 1.00] *)
    tWheelSlipHoldTimer         : TON;              (* WSP recovery hold duration timer *)

    (* Janney Coupler Visual Servoing Trajectory Tracking Variables *)
    rCouplerYawError            : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw angle error e_theta = theta_target - theta_actual [deg] *)
    rCouplerYawIntegral         : REAL := 0.0;      (* Yaw integral accumulator *)
    rCouplerPitchError          : REAL := 0.0;      (* Pitch angle error [deg] *)
    rCouplerKp                  : REAL := 4.8;      (* Proportional servo valve gain [%/deg] *)
    rCouplerKi                  : REAL := 0.35;     (* Integral servo valve gain [%/(deg*s)] *)
    rCouplerKd                  : REAL := 0.85;     (* Derivative servo valve gain [%/(deg/s)] *)
    rCouplerYawPrevError        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Previous scan yaw error for derivative calculation *)

    (* Sequence Timers & Multi-stage Case Machine *)
    iState                      : INT := 0;         (* Executive finite state index *)
    iSubState                   : INT := 0;         (* Secondary phase controller index *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;              (* State residence supervisor timer *)
    tCouplerSettleTimer         : TON;              (* Coupler hydraulic damping settle timer *)
    tLatchConfirmationTimer     : TON;              (* Knuckle locking pin seating confirmation timer *)
    tPullTestTimer              : TON;              (* Reverse tractive pull verification test timer *)
    tBrakePipeChargeTimer       : TON;              (* Train line pneumatic air charging timer *)

    (* Internal Flags & Diagnostics *)
    bPullTestPassed             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bCouplerAligned             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bFirstScanDone              : BOOL := FALSE;
    rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN: REAL := 450.0;
    rDynamicBrakeLimit_kN       : REAL := 380.0;
    rLocomotiveMass_Te          : REAL := 180.0;    (* 6-axle Co-Co battery-hybrid robot ballast weight [t] *)
    c_GravityAccel              : REAL := 9.81;     (* Standard gravity acceleration [m/s^2] *)
    c_Ts_Sec                    : REAL := 0.010;    (* Cyclic task execution delta time Ts = 10 ms *)
END_VAR

(* ====================================================================================================
   EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE:
   PHASE 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY ENVELOPE & 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY VOTING
   PHASE 2: CYBER-PHYSICAL RAILWAY RESISTANCE & CURTIUS-KNIFFLER ADHESION LIMITATION
   PHASE 3: HYBRID BATTERY-SUPERCAPACITOR MODEL PREDICTIVE ENERGY ARBITRATION
   PHASE 4: 6-DOF JANNEY COUPLER VISUAL SERVOING ALIGNMENT & DRAFT GEAR DAMPING
   PHASE 5: MULTI-STAGE SHUNTING & AUTOMATED COUPLING FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE)
   PHASE 6: 32-BIT COMPREHENSIVE ALARM MATRIX & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION ARBITRATION
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY ENVELOPE & 2oo3 TMR VOTING ALGORITHMS (IEC 61508 / EN 50129 SIL 4)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate Fail-Safe Emergency Stop Loop, Yard Perimeter Fence, and Ambient Thermal Bounds *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStop) OR (NOT bYardSafetyFenceInterlock) THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe Trip: De-energize all propulsion, dump brake pipe, clamp mechanical calipers *)
    bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
    bActiveMission               := FALSE;
    rBatteryPowerCmd_kW          := 0.0;
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW         := 0.0;
    rTotalTractiveEffort_kN      := 0.0;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN         := 0.0;
    rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar  := 3.8;    (* Maximum spring-applied air-exhausted clamp pressure *)
    rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct      := 0.0;
    rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct    := 0.0;
    bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid   := FALSE;
    wOperationState              := 16#E000; (* State 0xE000: EMERGENCY TRIP SHUTDOWN *)
    wAlarmWord01.0               := NOT bEmergencyStop;
    wAlarmWord01.1               := NOT bYardSafetyFenceInterlock;
    iDegradationLevel            := 4;       (* SIL 4 Maximum Safe Isolation Level *)
    iState                       := 999;     (* Jump directly to EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN state *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy Voting on Consist Speed Sensors:
   ChA = Doppler Radar, ChB = Axle Optical Encoder, ChC = Differential GNSS/INS *)
rVelDiff_AB := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChA - rAxleSpeed_ChB);
rVelDiff_BC := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChB - rAxleSpeed_ChC);
rVelDiff_CA := ABS(rAxleSpeed_ChC - rAxleSpeed_ChA);

(* Tolerance threshold for velocity channel divergence: 1.5 km/h *)
bVelDiscrepancy_AB := (rVelDiff_AB > 1.5);
bVelDiscrepancy_BC := (rVelDiff_BC > 1.5);
bVelDiscrepancy_CA := (rVelDiff_CA > 1.5);

(* Classical Median 2oo3 Selection Logic *)
IF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_AB) THEN
    (* ChA and ChB agree within tolerance: Vote is mean of ChA and ChB *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChA + rAxleSpeed_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_BC) THEN
    (* ChB and ChC agree: ChA is degraded *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChB + rAxleSpeed_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.0 := TRUE; (* Flag Sensor ChA Discrepancy *)
ELSIF (NOT bVelDiscrepancy_CA) THEN
    (* ChA and ChC agree: ChB is degraded *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := (rAxleSpeed_ChA + rAxleSpeed_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.1 := TRUE; (* Flag Sensor ChB Discrepancy *)
ELSE
    (* All three channels diverge: Tri-channel failure, take conservative maximum to prevent yard overspeed *)
    rVotedVelocity_kmh := MAX(rAxleSpeed_ChA, MAX(rAxleSpeed_ChB, rAxleSpeed_ChC));
    wAlarmWord02.2 := TRUE; (* Total 2oo3 Speed Sensor Failure Alarm *)
END_IF;

(* Filter velocity for smooth dynamics calculations: 1st order discrete low-pass filter (tau = 100 ms) *)
rFilteredVelocity := rFilteredVelocity + 0.09516 * (rVotedVelocity_kmh - rFilteredVelocity);

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting on Janney Coupler Yaw Angle Resolvers (Tolerance: 0.85 degrees) *)
IF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChA - rCouplerAzimuth_ChB) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChA + rCouplerAzimuth_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChB - rCouplerAzimuth_ChC) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChB + rCouplerAzimuth_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.3 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw ChA Discrepant *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerAzimuth_ChC - rCouplerAzimuth_ChA) <= 0.85) THEN
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := (rCouplerAzimuth_ChC + rCouplerAzimuth_ChA) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.4 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw ChB Discrepant *)
ELSE
    rVotedCouplerYaw_deg := rCouplerAzimuth_ChA; (* Degraded single channel fallback *)
    wAlarmWord02.5 := TRUE; (* Coupler Yaw 2oo3 Discrepancy Fault *)
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 TMR Voting on Drawbar Draft / Buff Load Strain Cells (Tolerance: 45.0 kN) *)
IF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB) * 0.5;
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.6 := TRUE; (* Draft Load Pin A Discrepant *)
ELSIF (ABS(rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC - rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA) <= 45.0) THEN
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord02.7 := TRUE; (* Draft Load Pin B Discrepant *)
ELSE
    rVotedDraftLoad_kN := (rCouplerDraftLoad_ChA + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChB + rCouplerDraftLoad_ChC) / 3.0;
    wAlarmWord02.8 := TRUE; (* Tri-channel draft load deviation *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 2: RAILWAY RESISTANCE ESTIMATION & CURTIUS-KNIFFLER ADHESION LIMITATION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Empirical Curtius-Kniffler rail-wheel friction characteristic:
   mu(v) = [c_CK_A / (v + c_CK_B) + c_CK_C] * rRailConditionDerateFactor *)
rCalculatedAdhesionCoeff := ((c_CK_A / (MAX(0.1, rVotedVelocity_kmh) + c_CK_B)) + c_CK_C) * rRailConditionDerateFactor;

(* Maximum adhesion-limited tractive effort before macro-slip: F_adh = mu * M_loco * g *)
rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN := (rCalculatedAdhesionCoeff * (rLocomotiveMass_Te * 1000.0) * c_GravityAccel) / 1000.0;

(* Clamp to structural draft gear and motor inverter hard limits (450 kN maximum continuous rating) *)
IF rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN > 450.0 THEN
    rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN := 450.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Modified Davis Train Resistance for the complete consist:
   F_resist = [c_Davis_A + c_Davis_B * v + c_Davis_C * v^2] * (M_consist + M_loco) + F_grade + F_curve *)
VAR_TEMP
    rTotalMass_Te   : REAL;
    rF_Rolling_kN   : REAL;
    rF_Grade_kN     : REAL;
    rF_Curve_kN     : REAL;
    rTotalResist_kN : REAL;
    rVelDiffSetpoint: REAL;
    rRequiredAccel  : REAL;
    rRawTractiveReq : REAL;
    rRawPowerReq_kW : REAL;
    rScCapacity_kW  : REAL;
    rBatCapacity_kW : REAL;
    rCreepDelta     : REAL;
    rPredictedImpactVel : REAL;
END_VAR

rTotalMass_Te   := rConsistMass_Te + rLocomotiveMass_Te;

(* Rolling and aerodynamic resistance [kN] *)
rF_Rolling_kN   := ((c_Davis_A + (c_Davis_B * rVotedVelocity_kmh) + (c_Davis_C * (rVotedVelocity_kmh * rVotedVelocity_kmh))) * rTotalMass_Te) / 1000.0;

(* Track gradient resistance: F_grade = TotalMass * g * (i_permille / 1000) [kN] *)
rF_Grade_kN     := (rTotalMass_Te * c_GravityAccel * rTrackGradient_Permille) / 1000.0;

(* Curve resistance (Roeckl's Empirical Heavy Rail Formula): F_curve = (650 / (Radius - 55)) * Mass * g / 1000 *)
IF (rTrackCurvatureRadius_m > 60.0) THEN
    rF_Curve_kN := ((650.0 / (rTrackCurvatureRadius_m - 55.0)) * rTotalMass_Te * c_GravityAccel) / 1000.0;
ELSE
    rF_Curve_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

rTotalResist_kN := rF_Rolling_kN + rF_Grade_kN + rF_Curve_kN;

(* Wheel Slip and Slide Protection (WSP) Creep Ratio Computation:
   lambda = (v_wheel_tach - v_ground_radar) / MAX(v_ground_radar, 0.5) *)
rCreepDelta := (rAxleSpeed_ChB - rVotedVelocity_kmh);
IF rVotedVelocity_kmh > 0.5 THEN
    rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct := (rCreepDelta / rVotedVelocity_kmh) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct := rCreepDelta * 20.0;
END_IF;

(* WSP Anti-Spin Control: Modulate torque if creep ratio exceeds optimal micro-slip band (2.5% to 5.0%) *)
IF (rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct > 5.0) THEN
    (* Severe wheel spin detected: Rapid torque shed *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor := MAX(0.15, rWspCorrectionFactor - 0.12);
    wAlarmWord02.9 := TRUE; (* WSP Active Wheel Spin Alarm *)
ELSIF (rEstimatedWheelCreep_pct < -5.0) THEN
    (* Severe wheel slide in dynamic braking: Reduce braking torque *)
    rWspCorrectionFactor := MAX(0.20, rWspCorrectionFactor - 0.10);
    wAlarmWord02.10 := TRUE; (* WSP Active Wheel Slide Alarm *)
ELSE
    (* Stable adhesion band: Ramp torque capacity back to 100% *)
    IF rWspCorrectionFactor < 1.0 THEN
        rWspCorrectionFactor := MIN(1.0, rWspCorrectionFactor + 0.02);
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord02.9  := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord02.10 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 3: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE ENERGY ALLOCATION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Discrete-Time Luenberger State Estimator Cycle (Ts = 0.010 s)
   Predictive Equation: x_hat[k+1] = A * x_hat[k] + B * u[k] + L * (y[k] - C * x_hat[k]) *)
VAR_TEMP
    rStateErr_v : REAL;
    rStateErr_s : REAL;
    rNewState_v : REAL;
    rNewState_s : REAL;
    rNewState_F : REAL;
END_VAR

(* Innovation: y - C * x_hat (where y = [v_voted_ms, draft_load_N]) *)
rStateErr_v := (rVotedVelocity_kmh / 3.6) - rObsState_v_ms;
rStateErr_s := 0.0; (* Distance sensor not directly continuous, bounded via ToF LiDAR during approach *)

rNewState_v := (matA_11 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_12 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_13 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_11 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_11 * rStateErr_v);

rNewState_s := (matA_21 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_22 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_23 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_21 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_21 * rStateErr_v);

rNewState_F := (matA_31 * rObsState_v_ms) + (matA_32 * rObsState_s_m) + (matA_33 * rObsState_F_N) 
               + (matB_31 * (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * 1000.0)) + (matL_31 * rStateErr_v);

(* Commit updated state estimates *)
rObsState_v_ms := MAX(0.0, rNewState_v);
rObsState_s_m  := rNewState_s;
rObsState_F_N  := rNewState_F;

(* Compute Required Acceleration & Force Request based on Target Speed and Jerk Profile *)
rVelDiffSetpoint := rTargetVelocity - rVotedVelocity_kmh;

(* Smooth acceleration rate profiling: max yard acceleration 0.15 m/s^2 (0.54 km/h/s) to protect freight cargo *)
IF rVelDiffSetpoint > 0.0 THEN
    rRequiredAccel := MIN(0.18, rVelDiffSetpoint * 0.12); (* m/s^2 *)
    rRawTractiveReq := ((rTotalMass_Te * 1000.0) * rRequiredAccel / 1000.0) + rTotalResist_kN;
    rRawTractiveReq := MIN(rRawTractiveReq, rMaxTractiveEffortAllowed_kN) * rWspCorrectionFactor;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 0.0;
ELSIF rVelDiffSetpoint < -0.1 THEN
    (* Service Deceleration Profile *)
    rRequiredAccel := MAX(-0.25, rVelDiffSetpoint * 0.15); (* m/s^2 *)
    rRawTractiveReq := 0.0;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := ABS(((rTotalMass_Te * 1000.0) * rRequiredAccel / 1000.0) + rTotalResist_kN);
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := MIN(rRegenBrakeEffort_kN, rDynamicBrakeLimit_kN) * rWspCorrectionFactor;
ELSE
    rRequiredAccel  := 0.0;
    rRawTractiveReq := MAX(0.0, rTotalResist_kN * 0.5);
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;

rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := rRawTractiveReq;

(* Convert Tractive Force to Net Mechanical Power Demand [kW]: P = (F_kN * v_kmh) / 3.6 *)
rRawPowerReq_kW := (rTotalTractiveEffort_kN * MAX(1.0, rVotedVelocity_kmh)) / 3.6;

(* Model Predictive Frequency Power Split between Battery and Supercapacitor:
   The Battery pack has high specific energy (Wh/kg) but degrades rapidly under high C-rates (thermal stress).
   The Supercapacitor bank has high specific power (W/kg) with 1,000,000+ cycle life.
   Architecture: Low-pass filter baseline to Battery, High-pass dynamic transient jerk to Supercapacitor. *)

(* Low-pass filter for battery baseline demand (tau_bat = 2.5 seconds, alpha = 0.00398 at 10ms scan) *)
rFilteredBatteryPower := rFilteredBatteryPower + 0.0040 * (rRawPowerReq_kW - rFilteredBatteryPower);

(* Enforce Battery C-rate and SoC limits *)
IF (rBatterySoC < 20.0) OR (rBatteryCellMaxTemp_DegC > 52.0) THEN
    (* Thermal or low SoC derating *)
    rBatCapacity_kW := 250.0;
    iDegradationLevel := MAX(iDegradationLevel, 2);
    wAlarmWord01.4 := TRUE; (* Battery Derating Flag *)
ELSE
    rBatCapacity_kW := 750.0;
    wAlarmWord01.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rBatteryPowerCmd_kW := MIN(rBatCapacity_kW, rFilteredBatteryPower);

(* Supercapacitor allocation: absorbs the high-frequency difference (dP/dt peak breakaway burst) *)
rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := (rRawPowerReq_kW - rBatteryPowerCmd_kW);

(* Supercapacitor State-of-Charge Management (Stabilize around rTargetSuperCapSoC = 70%) *)
IF (rSuperCapSoC < 35.0) THEN
    (* Supercap depleted: Restrict discharge, divert up to 80 kW battery power to recharge SC during cruise *)
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := MAX(0.0, rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW * 0.35);
    IF (rVotedVelocity_kmh > 3.0) AND (rBatteryPowerCmd_kW < 400.0) THEN
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW := rBatteryPowerCmd_kW + 65.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := -65.0; (* DC-DC buck charges supercap *)
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord01.5 := TRUE; (* Supercap Low SoC *)
ELSIF (rSuperCapSoC > 92.0) THEN
    (* Supercap nearly full: Cannot absorb full dynamic regen energy without overvoltage *)
    IF rRegenBrakeEffort_kN > 0.0 THEN
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := -150.0;
        (* Transfer excess braking energy to mechanical tread brakes *)
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 1.8;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord01.6 := TRUE; (* Supercap High Voltage/SoC *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord01.5 := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord01.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Supercapacitor Power Setpoint to converter envelope *)
rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := LIMIT(-950.0, rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW, 950.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 4: 6-DOF AUTOMATED JANNEY COUPLER VISUAL SERVOING CONTROLLER
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Laser Profilometer / Stereoscopic Vision Servo Loop:
   AAR Type F tightlock coupler gathering range: +/- 110 mm horizontal, +/- 80 mm vertical.
   Beyond this gathering horn window, automatic mechanical interlock is physically impossible. *)

rCouplerYawError := 0.0 - rVotedCouplerYaw_deg; (* Target centerline is 0.0 deg *)

(* Apply vision guidance offset if target wagon is visible within 12.0 meters *)
IF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 0.05) AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 12.0) THEN
    (* Convert lateral misalignment [mm] into angular trimming bias *)
    rCouplerYawError := rCouplerYawError + (rCouplerLateralMisalign_mm * 0.035);
    rCouplerPitchError := (0.0 - rCouplerElevation_deg) + (rCouplerVerticalMisalign_mm * 0.025);
ELSE
    rCouplerPitchError := 0.0 - rCouplerElevation_deg;
END_IF;

(* PID Hydraulic Proportional Valve Control *)
rCouplerYawIntegral := LIMIT(-30.0, rCouplerYawIntegral + (rCouplerYawError * c_Ts_Sec), 30.0);

rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct := (rCouplerKp * rCouplerYawError) 
                         + (rCouplerKi * rCouplerYawIntegral) 
                         + (rCouplerKd * (rCouplerYawError - rCouplerYawPrevError) / c_Ts_Sec);

rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct, 100.0);
rCouplerYawPrevError    := rCouplerYawError;

(* Pitch proportional valve control *)
rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rCouplerPitchError * 7.5, 100.0);

(* Check alignment tolerance: horizontal within +/- 15 mm, yaw within +/- 0.5 deg *)
bCouplerAligned := (ABS(rVotedCouplerYaw_deg) < 0.6) AND (ABS(rCouplerLateralMisalign_mm) < 20.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 5: MULTI-STAGE SHUNTING & AUTOMATED COUPLING FINITE STATE MACHINE
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & BUILT-IN SELF-TEST (BIST)
          ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState             := 16#0001;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bActiveMission              := FALSE;
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW         := 0.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW        := 0.0;
        rTotalTractiveEffort_kN     := 0.0;
        rRegenBrakeEffort_kN        := 0.0;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5; (* Full holding brake *)
        rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct     := 0.0;
        rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct   := 0.0;
        bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid  := FALSE;
        bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd  := FALSE;
        bPullTestPassed             := FALSE;

        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify 2oo3 sensor health before exiting BIST *)
            IF (NOT wAlarmWord02.2) AND (rBatteryBusVoltage > 620.0) AND (rSuperCapVoltage > 250.0) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to STANDBY READY *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord01.2 := TRUE; (* Self-Test Fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: STANDBY & DISPATCH MISSION ARBITRATION
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0010;
        bSystemReady    := TRUE;
        bActiveMission  := FALSE;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5; (* Hold parking clamp *)

        IF bEnable AND (rTargetVelocity > 0.1) THEN
            (* Release holding brakes, transition to Dynamic Tractive Haul *)
            rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;
            bActiveMission := TRUE;
            iState := 20; (* Transition to TRACTIVE_HAUL *)
        ELSIF bEnable AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 0.05) AND (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 20.0) THEN
            (* Automated Coupling Mission Profile requested by Yard Controller *)
            rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;
            bActiveMission := TRUE;
            iState := 40; (* Transition to COUPLER_APPROACH *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: DYNAMIC TRACTIVE HAUL & SPEED REGULATION
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0020;
        bActiveMission  := TRUE;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;

        (* Maintain continuous tractive effort and hybrid power split computed in Phases 2 and 3 *)
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR (rTargetVelocity <= 0.05) THEN
            (* Graceful deceleration to stand *)
            IF rVotedVelocity_kmh < 0.2 THEN
                rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := 0.0;
                rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5;
                iState := 10; (* Return to STANDBY *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 40: AUTOMATED JANNEY COUPLER APPROACH & VISUAL SERVOING
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0040;
        bActiveMission  := TRUE;

        (* Automated Approach Profile: Taper speed as distance to target closes:
           Distance > 5m: speed = 3.5 km/h
           Distance 1.5m to 5m: speed = 1.8 km/h
           Distance < 1.5m: speed = 0.8 km/h (Strict AAR S-100 Latching Spec: 0.5 to 1.2 km/h) *)
        IF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 5.0) THEN
            rTargetVelocity := 3.5;
        ELSIF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m > 1.5) THEN
            rTargetVelocity := 1.8;
        ELSE
            rTargetVelocity := 0.8;
        END_IF;

        (* Engage Coupler Articulation Actuators *)
        IF NOT bCouplerKnuckleOpen THEN
            (* Unlock pin and open gathering jaw prior to engagement *)
            bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid := FALSE;
        END_IF;

        (* Verify knuckle contact closure: distance < 0.12m and impact load detected *)
        IF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 0.15) OR (rVotedDraftLoad_kN < -35.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to COUPLER_ENGAGEMENT *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 50: CONTROLLED BUFF IMPACT & MECHANICAL LATCHING
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0050;

        (* Absorb buff shock via Supercapacitor rapid regenerative burst:
           Calculated Kinetic Energy = 0.5 * M_loco * v^2 [kJ] *)
        rPredictedImpactVel := MAX(0.1, rVotedVelocity_kmh / 3.6);
        rEstimatedCouplingImpact_kJ := 0.5 * (rLocomotiveMass_Te * 1000.0) * (rPredictedImpactVel * rPredictedImpactVel) / 1000.0;

        (* Neutralize tractive effort immediately upon impact contact *)
        rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := 0.0;
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW     := 0.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW    := -180.0; (* Absorb draft gear surge *)
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 1.2; (* Gentle tread brake application *)

        (* Await mechanical Janney lock pin drop confirmation *)
        tLatchConfirmationTimer(IN := bCouplerKnuckleLatched, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tLatchConfirmationTimer.Q THEN
            tLatchConfirmationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 60; (* Transition to VERIFICATION PULL-TEST *)
        END_IF;

        (* Impact Timeout Watchdog: If pin doesn't latch within 6.0 seconds, abort *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmWord01.7 := TRUE; (* Coupler Failed to Latch Alarm *)
            iState := 80; (* Transition to COUPLING_ABORT *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 60: POST-LATCHING DRAFT GEAR PULL-TEST (AAR INTEGRITY PROOF)
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0060;
        (* Apply controlled reverse tractive effort (+120 kN draft tension) for 3.0s:
           If knuckle pin did not seat, the cars will separate immediately, preventing runaways *)
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 0.0;
        rTotalTractiveEffort_kN     := 125.0; (* Reverse drawbar tensile pull *)

        tPullTestTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3500MS);
        IF (rVotedDraftLoad_kN > 90.0) AND tPullTestTimer.Q THEN
            (* Draft load sustained above 90 kN: Coupling is physically solid *)
            tPullTestTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rTotalTractiveEffort_kN    := 0.0;
            bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd := TRUE; (* Automatically connect pneumatic brake line *)
            bPullTestPassed            := TRUE;
            iState                     := 70;   (* Transition to BRAKE_PIPE_CHARGE *)
        ELSIF tPullTestTimer.Q AND (rVotedDraftLoad_kN <= 90.0) THEN
            (* Separation detected! Knuckle slipped open *)
            tPullTestTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := 0.0;
            wAlarmWord01.8 := TRUE; (* Pull Test Failed Alarm *)
            iState := 80; (* Abort *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 70: TRAIN LINE PNEUMATIC BRAKE PIPE CHARGING & CONSIST MERGE
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0070;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5; (* Anchor shunter while train line charges *)

        tBrakePipeChargeTimer(IN := bBrakePipePressureCharged, PT := T#5S);
        IF tBrakePipeChargeTimer.Q THEN
            tBrakePipeChargeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Consist fully coupled, integrated, and air brakes charged *)
            iState := 10; (* Return to STANDBY READY as unified heavy-haul consist *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 80: COUPLING ABORT & RETRACTION MANEUVER
           ----------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState := 16#0080;
        bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd := FALSE;
        bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid := TRUE; (* Lift lock pin to free knuckle *)

        (* Reverse away safely to 2.5 meters distance *)
        IF (rCouplerTargetDistance_m < 2.5) THEN
            rTargetVelocity := -2.0; (* Back away at 2 km/h *)
        ELSE
            rTargetVelocity := 0.0;
            rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.5;
            IF bReset THEN
                wAlarmWord01.7 := FALSE;
                wAlarmWord01.8 := FALSE;
                iState := 10;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    999: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------
            STATE 999: FAIL-SAFE EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN (TRIPPED)
            ---------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wOperationState             := 16#0999;
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bActiveMission              := FALSE;
        rBatteryPowerCmd_kW         := 0.0;
        rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW        := 0.0;
        rTotalTractiveEffort_kN     := 0.0;
        rRegenBrakeEffort_kN        := 0.0;
        rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.8;
        rCouplerYawValveCmd_pct     := 0.0;
        rCouplerPitchValveCmd_pct   := 0.0;
        bCouplerPinReleaseSolenoid  := FALSE;
        bCouplerAirLineGladHandCmd  := FALSE;

        (* Require Master Reset and E-Stop loop restoration to re-arm *)
        IF bReset AND bEmergencyStop AND bYardSafetyFenceInterlock THEN
            wAlarmWord01 := 16#0000;
            wAlarmWord02 := 16#0000;
            iDegradationLevel := 0;
            iState := 0; (* Re-enter BIST *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Defensive programming default *)
        iState := 999;
END_CASE;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PHASE 6: 32-BIT COMPREHENSIVE ALARM MATRIX & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION ARBITRATION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Evaluate Thermal and Voltage Safety Limits *)
IF (rBatteryCellMaxTemp_DegC > 58.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord01.9 := TRUE; (* Battery Critical Thermal Runaway Risk *)
    iState := 999;          (* Emergency trip *)
END_IF;

IF (rSuperCapCoreTemp_DegC > 70.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord01.10 := TRUE; (* Supercap Core Overtemperature *)
    rSuperCapPowerCmd_kW := 0.0; (* Disengage SC chopper *)
    iDegradationLevel := MAX(iDegradationLevel, 1);
END_IF;

IF (rBatteryBusVoltage > 880.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord01.11 := TRUE; (* Main DC Link Overvoltage *)
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 0.0; (* Cut dynamic braking *)
    rPneumaticBrakePressure_bar := 3.8; (* Dump mechanical friction brakes *)
END_IF;

IF (rVotedVelocity_kmh > 26.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord01.12 := TRUE; (* Yard Overspeed Limit Violation (>25 km/h) *)
    rTotalTractiveEffort_kN := 0.0;
    rRegenBrakeEffort_kN := 250.0;
END_IF;

(* Clear transient flags upon master reset *)
IF bReset THEN
    wAlarmWord01.2  := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord01.7  := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord01.8  := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord01.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
